problem.title: Why Traditional Insurance Fails SMEs
problem.cloudDependencyDesc: 73% of Tunisian SMEs rely on cloud infrastructure. When it fails, revenue stops — but your costs don't. Salaries, rent, subscriptions keep draining cash while you wait for service to return.
problem.paperworkDesc: Standard business interruption insurance requires months of financial records, proof of loss, adjuster visits, and legal review. By the time you get paid, you might be out of business. SMEs need speed, not bureaucracy.
problem.solutionDesc: We use objective IODA data — not opinions. If Georgia Tech's Internet Intelligence detects your provider's outage exceeded their SLA MTTR, you get paid. Automatically. In minutes. No adjusters, no lawyers, no waiting.

ioda.title: What is IODA?
ioda.description: The Internet Outage Data Aggregator (IODA) is a project by Georgia Tech and CAIDA that monitors global internet connectivity using BGP routing data (500+ monitors), active probing (CAIDA Ark), and network telescopes. It detects outages in real-time with no dependency on the provider's own reporting.

howItWorks.title: How Parametric Insurance Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Four simple steps to protect your business from cloud downtime. Zero paperwork, total automation.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Select from {{count}} monitored Tunisian cloud providers. Each has a defined SLA tier and MTTR threshold.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Enter your revenue, margin, and risk profile. The actuarial engine calculates your premium and payout rate.
howItWorks.step3Desc: IODA watches your provider via BGP, active probing, and network telescopes. Real outage data, not self-reported.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Outage exceeds MTTR? Claim created, approved, and paid automatically. No forms, no waiting.

control.title: 3-Layer Hybrid Control
control.subtitle: Automation for speed. Admin oversight for trust. Policy approval for quality. Three layers working together.
control.layer1Desc: Claims are auto-created when IODA detects an outage exceeding MTTR. Auto-approved and auto-paid for speed. Customers get paid in minutes, not months.
control.layer2Desc: Admins can dispute any auto-claim within 48 hours. Disputed claims are held pending investigation. This prevents fraud while maintaining payout speed for legitimate claims.
control.layer3Desc: Every parametric policy requires admin approval before activation. This ensures only legitimate businesses with verified providers get coverage. Quality gate before automation starts.
